display_selection: Original display pairs retained except rounds 5 and 7. For those two rounds, the smallest existing upright pair index was selected after the run in response to the presentation request, without choosing on responses or graph scores. Graph updates still use the original four-pair batches, including unshown contexts.
private_materials: New presentation scripts, research implementation, training data and model weights are not included in this public website.
scope: Recorded physical simulation with frozen encoder and ACC, followed by revisable graph scoring. Initial 12-round run plus a later eight-round continuation. Reference colors are for display only. A 5 mm F1 grasp correction preceded the complete accepted eight-round continuation; learning rules and thresholds were unchanged.

stages.name: Introduction
stages.en: Seven physical nodes. One shown pair per round; all four pairs are used for each graph update.
stages.zh: 七个物理节点。每轮展示一对操作，图更新使用完整四对数据。

stages.name: Round 1
stages.en: Round 1 · Test F4: operate, observe, then revise the current graph.
stages.zh: 第1轮 · 测试F4：操作、观察，再修订当前图。

stages.name: Round 2
stages.en: Round 2 · Test F1 with a matched pair of robot operations.
stages.zh: 第2轮 · 对F1进行配对机械臂操作。

stages.name: Round 3
stages.en: Round 3 · Test the pusher P; graph revisions can also introduce wrong hypotheses.
stages.zh: 第3轮 · 测试推杆P；图修订也可能引入错误假设。

stages.name: Round 4
stages.en: Round 4 · Test the bell B and compare the recorded visual responses.
stages.zh: 第4轮 · 测试铃B，对比记录到的视觉响应。

stages.name: Round 5
stages.en: Round 5 · Hold versus push F1, starting upright in both shown trials.
stages.zh: 第5轮 · 夹持与推动F1，两次展示试验均从竖直状态开始。

stages.name: Round 6
stages.en: Round 6 · Test F1 again and accumulate intervention evidence.
stages.zh: 第6轮 · 再次测试F1，积累干预证据。

stages.name: Round 7
stages.en: Round 7 · Hold versus push F3. The shown pair changes F3 but no other readout; the graph stays unchanged.
stages.zh: 第7轮 · 夹持与推动F3。展示配对中仅F3读数改变；本轮图保持不变。

stages.name: Round 8
stages.en: Round 8 · Test F2; retain the current graph while collecting more evidence.
stages.zh: 第8轮 · 测试F2，继续收集证据，当前图未改变。

stages.name: Round 9
stages.en: Round 9 · Test F3 again. No structural update in this round.
stages.zh: 第9轮 · 再次测试F3，本轮没有结构更新。

stages.name: Round 10
stages.en: Round 10 · Another paired F3 test; an unchanged graph is also retained in the film.
stages.zh: 第10轮 · 再做F3配对测试；图不变的轮次也保留在视频中。

stages.name: Round 11
stages.en: Round 11 · Test F3; the false F3→F2 hypothesis still remains.
stages.zh: 第11轮 · 测试F3，错误假设F3→F2仍然存在。

stages.name: Round 12
stages.en: Round 12 · Test F2. The original twelve-round budget ends with one extra edge.
stages.zh: 第12轮 · 测试F2，最初十二轮预算结束时仍多一条边。

stages.name: Continuation
stages.en: Eight additional rounds were requested. The actuator correction is disclosed; the models and learning rule remain frozen.
stages.zh: 随后追加八轮；视频说明执行器修正，模型与学图规则不变。

stages.name: Round 13
stages.en: Round 13 · Test F3; continue from the round-12 graph.
stages.zh: 第13轮 · 测试F3，从第12轮的图继续。

stages.name: Round 14
stages.en: Round 14 · Test F3 before revising the remaining false hypothesis.
stages.zh: 第14轮 · 测试F3，再修订残留的错误假设。

stages.name: Round 14 update
stages.en: Withdraw F3→F2, but propose another wrong edge: F1→F2.
stages.zh: 撤回F3→F2，但又提出错误边F1→F2。

stages.name: Round 15
stages.en: Round 15 · Test F1; the new hypothesis is still retained.
stages.zh: 第15轮 · 测试F1，暂时保留新的假设。

stages.name: Round 16
stages.en: Round 16 · Repeat the F1 comparison and accumulate evidence.
stages.zh: 第16轮 · 重复F1对照，继续积累证据。

stages.name: Round 17
stages.en: Round 17 · Test F4. The graph has not changed yet.
stages.zh: 第17轮 · 测试F4，当前图尚未改变。

stages.name: Round 18
stages.en: Round 18 · Compare paired F1 operations before the final correction.
stages.zh: 第18轮 · 对比F1配对操作，随后完成最后一次纠正。

stages.name: Round 18 update
stages.en: Withdraw F1→F2. The six learned edges now match the simulator reference.
stages.zh: 撤回F1→F2，此时六条学到的边与仿真参考图一致。

stages.name: Round 19
stages.en: Round 19 · Test F2; the corrected graph stays unchanged.
stages.zh: 第19轮 · 测试F2，纠正后的图保持不变。

stages.name: Round 20
stages.en: Round 20 · Test F2 again; retain the final graph.
stages.zh: 第20轮 · 再次测试F2，保留最终图。

stages.name: Final graph
stages.en: Final six-edge graph. All 20 rounds retained; reference colors were never supplied to learning.
stages.zh: 最终六条边，完整保留20轮；参考图配色从未提供给学图过程。
